import re

def parse_labeled_grids(text):
    out={}
    lines=text.splitlines()
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        m=re.search(r'(?:Demo pair \d+ )?(input|output) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):',line)
        if m:
            key=m.group(1); h=int(m.group(2)); w=int(m.group(3))
            gr=[list(map(int,lines[i+j+1].split())) for j in range(h)]
            assert all(len(row)==w for row in gr),(key,h,[len(r) for r in gr])
            out[key]=gr
    return out
pairs=[parse_labeled_grids(t) for t in user_contents]
